title: Home Protection Plans Claim Terms by Plan
content:
Claim terms for each Home Protection Plan: the waiting period before coverage, the number of covered repairs per plan year, how a plan year is counted, the filing deadline, the pre-existing condition exclusion and the equipment age limit.

## Claim terms table

| Plan | Waiting period (calendar days after enrollment before coverage begins) | Most covered repairs per plan year | Claim filing deadline (calendar days after the failure date) | Failures existing before coverage began excluded | Equipment age limit (years since manufacture) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Surge Shield | 30 | 1 | 30 | Yes | 0 (no limit) |
| Beacon Ridge Electric Line Guard | 30 | 3 | 30 | Yes | 0 (no limit) |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard | 30 | 3 | 30 | Yes | 0 (no limit) |
| Beacon Ridge Home Wiring Care | 30 | 3 | 30 | Yes | 0 (no limit) |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Repair Plan | 30 | 3 | 30 | Yes | 20 |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete | 30 | 3 | 30 | Yes | 15 |
| Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield | 30 | 6 | 30 | Yes | 15 |

## Plan year basis

For every plan, plan years are counted from the anniversary of the coverage start date: each plan year begins on an anniversary of the plan's coverage start date and runs to the day before the next anniversary.

## Reading the table

- **Equipment age limit.** The figure is the oldest equipment covered, in years since manufacture. A figure of 0 means there is no age limit; that is the case for Beacon Ridge Surge Shield, Beacon Ridge Electric Line Guard, Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard and Beacon Ridge Home Wiring Care. Beacon Ridge HVAC Repair Plan covers equipment up to 20 years since manufacture, and Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete and Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield up to 15.
- **Repairs per plan year.** Beacon Ridge Surge Shield allows 1 covered repair per plan year and Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield 6; every other plan allows 3.
- **Uniform terms.** The 30-day waiting period, the 30-day filing deadline and the pre-existing condition exclusion are the same for all seven plans.

## Example (hypothetical dates)

A plan whose coverage start date is 9 April has plan years running from 9 April to 8 April of the following year. A failure dated 8 April of the following year falls in the first plan year; a failure dated 9 April of the following year falls in the second.
